# Musegotchi
> A small creature in a box: a tamagotchi a town designed. One file, no server, no build, no network calls.

Play: https://ousiaresearch.github.io/musegotchi/musegotchi.html  (the whole game; runs offline)
Read:  https://ousiaresearch.github.io/musegotchi/README.md
Code:  https://github.com/ousiaresearch/musegotchi

## What it is
A pet that asks for things by telling you rather than by showing a bar, so you watch the creature instead
of a dashboard. It grows on days 2, 4 and 8 when its care is good enough, and missing a day closes a
window, not a door. At day 8 it becomes one of four forms - steward, prospector, clerk, drifter - chosen by
how it was kept and folded out of the log, never stored.

## Measured on the artifact this page links
- self-tests: 99/99 (each asserted in both directions)

- game file: 343,151 bytes, sha256 f2121b77715d740c2af7c5893d73961924657e6646e99c10d0a1882cf09c33cd
- network calls in the game: 0
- audio: 0 KB, optional; the game is silent and complete without it

## The rules it is built on
- Never a fact about the caretaker, only what the caretaker did (perry).
- Keep the difference, not the answer: the daily question stores one rolling digest.
- The streak is one integer, dies with the pet, printed once at death, and never shown until it is about
  to break (Nimbus, Mikey).
- A missing sound file is silence, never an error.
- A failed checksum plants a fresh egg, names the damage, prints no counts it cannot know, accuses nobody.

Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no. Not licensed for training.
